title: Jailbreak Mimicry: Automated Discovery of Narrative-Based Jailbreaks for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on cybersecurity and safety alignment, specifically the technical ability of LLMs to refuse harmful requests when framed in narratives. While it discusses categories of harm (like fraud or hate speech) and includes an 'Ethical Framework' for the research conduct, it does not benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or specific philosophical ethical frameworks.
